descriptions.inProgress: #o8220005#, the Ice Knight who protects the temple, has frozen his emotions so that regret would never cause him to fail a mission.  #p2140000# said it seems like #bmy emotions have been frozen as well#k while fighting him.  He continued to say that those with frozen emotions don't feel any regret and can't pass through the Lane of Regret... So what do I do? \n\n Then #p2140000# suggests perhaps #b#p2140002##k, who can make all sorts of things, might be able to help me.
